test_T2I_single_gpu: test the TestFlux_T2V class single_gpu method to generate an image from a text prompt using SGLang CLI
test_T2I_verify: test the CLIBase verify method to validate CLI command output and image file existence
test_T2I_command: test the CLIBase get_base_command method to build the sglang generate CLI command for text-to-image
test_T2I_run_command: test the CLIBase _run_command method to execute sglang generate with model path and extra args
run_T2I_perf: run the TestFlux_T2V unittest to benchmark text-to-image generation performance with Flux 1 Dev model
